title: American Civil War
summary: Brother fought brother across four years of slaughter that preserved the Union and ended slavery in America.

stories.title: The Civil War
stories.summary: Five battles from Fort Sumter to Appomattox that defined the conflict.

events.title: Fort Sumter
events.body: Confederate artillery opened fire on the federal garrison in Charleston harbour. The surrender of Fort Sumter began the bloodiest war in American history.

events.title: First Bull Run
events.body: Union troops marched toward Richmond but were routed at Manassas. Both sides realised the war would not end in a single summer campaign.

events.title: Antietam
events.body: Lee's invasion of Maryland ended in the bloodiest single day of the war. The tactical draw gave Lincoln the political cover to issue the Emancipation Proclamation.

events.title: Gettysburg
events.body: Lee's second invasion of the North culminated in three days of fighting in Pennsylvania. Pickett's Charge failed and the Army of Northern Virginia retreated, never to recover its offensive power.

events.title: Appomattox
events.body: Grant's armies trapped Lee at Appomattox Court House. Lee surrendered the Army of Northern Virginia, effectively ending the Confederacy's ability to fight.

stories.title: Reconstruction
stories.summary: Rebuilding the South and redefining citizenship after the war.
